newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 25.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices were steady in thin demand, traders said. Enquires were healthy but shipowners were unwilling to buy because they expected prices to fall on increased MidEast supplies, they said. A major sold prompt 180-cst supplies, loading in the next two days, at $124/tonne. Bunker 380-cst was quoted around $119, MDO around $210 and gas oil around $222. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
